structure.layout: single-column centered utility landing page: minimal logo header, hero with eyebrow + H1, dashed dropzone as the main tool, 3-step how-it-works strip, promo card, conversion reference table, two cross-sell callout cards, FAQ accordion, multilingual footer

aesthetics.typography: Fraunces (soft serif, italic in H1 'Word', headings, card/FAQ titles, logo wordmark); Hanken Grotesk (body, subhead, table cells, footer links); JetBrains Mono (eyebrow, 'Markdown' in H1, file chips, step numbers, code cells, small meta notes)
aesthetics.typeScale: H1 72px mixing Fraunces italic bold 'Word', light grotesk 'to', and mono 'Markdown'; H2 30px Fraunces semibold; card titles 20px; subhead 20px; body 14-16px; mono meta 11-13px with wide letterspacing on the eyebrow

notes: Warm off-white paper background with a faint dot-grid texture in the upper margins. Character comes from the three-typeface H1 (serif italic 'Word', light sans 'to', monospace 'Markdown') echoing the docx→md conversion. Olive (#646a00) + pale lime chip fills (#f0f0c8-ish) used for icons, step numbers, code output and links; dropzone uses a 2px dashed grey border with circular lime icon. Privacy messaging is repeated throughout ('never uploaded'). The only dark element is the navy book promo card with a 3D book cover. Footer offers 21 language links with the current language in olive.
